brand_notes: Bison Monitor ($2,300/pair, 8 Ω rating, 5.25 in woofer, Canada-built) replaced the Sky Monitor with 43% larger cabinet (hifinews-totem-acoustic-bison-monitor). Totem sells Bison Tower/Twin Tower at higher prices (audiophilia-totem-acoustic-bison-monitor).
takeaways: Only Tier-B data: Hi-Fi News lab (no spinorama)
Min impedance 5.4 Ω @228 Hz vs 8 Ω rating: below-iec; EPDR 2.8 Ω
Sensitivity 84.8 dB mean (87.8 at 1 kHz bump) vs 87 claimed
~3 dB bump 800 Hz-1.3 kHz; LF -6 dB at 41 Hz re 200 Hz
Critics: imaging and mid clarity praised; bass tuneful not deep
conflicts: Claimed 87 dB vs 84.8 dB measured mean
Maker weight 13.49 kg vs HFN 5 kg each; HFN height 850 mm typo
